title: Throughput-first design philosophy
rationale: Future workloads are increasingly parallel and power-constrained
outcome: Designed for high throughput on multi-threaded workloads

title: 32-way multithreading via 8 cores with 4-way SMT
decision: Implemented 8 cores each with 4-way simultaneous multithreading
rationale: Hide memory latency and maximize thread-level parallelism

title: Shared L2 cache among all cores
decision: Used a shared L2 cache architecture
rationale: Improve cache utilization efficiency for multi-threaded workloads
outcome: Reduced overall cache area and power overhead
weakest_point: exact cache size and organization details

title: Small per-core L1 caches
decision: Used small L1 instruction and data caches per core
rationale: Balance latency, area, and power consumption for targeted throughput workloads
outcome: Met latency requirements while staying within area and power budgets
weakest_point: exact cache sizes and whether they were explicitly justified

title: Power-aware design for server workloads
decision: Designed for power efficiency to maximize throughput per watt
rationale: Power is a first-order design constraint for server processors
outcome: Achieved high throughput per watt for target workloads
weakest_point: specific power metrics and comparisons to alternatives
